description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

SpiderRock Platform Services, LLC is hiring a new graduate Software Engineer to contribute to the design and development of the SpiderRock Platform. The role involves developing software and APIs, troubleshooting and supporting clients, and assisting with integrations and software quality assurance.
New Graduate Software Engineer supporting .NET/C# API configuration, GUI/MySQL/REST debugging, client integration, and software quality assurance

Responsibilities:
• Utilize .Net/C# software developer skills
• Assist in debugging and analyzing our user APIs and interfaces (GUI, MySQL, REST API)
• Work on challenging and complex projects
• Learn about the financial markets
• Develop and configure new API configurations based on client needs
• Work with IT and client support teams to troubleshoot issues
• Deep-Dive learning sessions on the SpiderRock software philosophy
• Contribute to our client support team's software quality assurance
• Assist integration efforts for SpiderRock's growing client base
• Work with clients to enhance the onboarding experience

Requirements:
• New Graduates ( December 2026 or May 2027 )
• a desire to learn
• a strong desire to contribute to our team's fast paced development cycle
• BS or BA in Math, Engineering, Computer Science or relevant field or experience
• Strong acumen in software development
• Debugging experience
• Demonstrable .NET/C#/JAVA/C++/Python/PowerShell experience
• Exposure to Windows environment
• A strong analytical and problem solving approach
• Understanding of a project life cycle and methodology (i.e. Agile, Scrum)
• Strong work ethic
• Communication with end users, assessing requirements and managing expectations professionally
• Independent project and time management
• Professional, motivated attitude
• Strong interpersonal skills
